market_summary: US markets ended mixed with Nasdaq hitting a record high (+0.5%) while S&P 500 slipped 0.3% and Dow fell 1.3%, as softer September jobs data (29,000 added vs expectations) eased Fed rate hike odds to ~18-20%. Bond yields spiked to highest levels since 2002 at 5.34% mid-week before retreating. Semiconductor stocks rallied on AI capex strength. In Singapore, the STI fell 1.3% as elevated US bond yields pressured valuations; however, SGX board lot reduction effective Oct 5 makes major counters more accessible to retail investors.

items.headline: Tesla Q3 Deliveries Beat Estimates at 486,532, Stock Up 5.5%; On Pace for First Annual Delivery Increase Since 2023
items.summary: Tesla delivered 486,532 vehicles in Q3 2026, beating analyst consensus of 461,974 by 5.3%. Year-to-date through nine months, Tesla has delivered 1.32M vehicles, about 9% more than 2025, putting it on pace for first annual delivery growth since 2023.

items.headline: Nvidia Stock Hits New All-Time Intraday High as AI Infrastructure Demand Continues; Market Cap Reaches $5.7 Trillion
items.summary: Nvidia reached intraday record of $237.55 per share with market cap at $5.7 trillion. Stock gained as much as 3% before closing up 1.3%, extending a 23% rally from late July lows amid continued AI capex spending by major cloud providers.

items.headline: Google Faces £1 Billion UK Consumer Lawsuit Over Play Store Fees as Trial Begins
items.summary: UK Competition Appeal Tribunal trial began October 5 for £1 billion collective claim on behalf of approximately 20 million UK consumers alleging Google abused dominant position to overcharge via Play Store commissions up to 30%. Extended claim period now covers purchases between October 2015 and January 2026.

items.headline: SGX Board Lot Reduction Effective October 5; DBS, OCBC, UOB and Other Blue-Chips Now Trade in Smaller Quantities
items.summary: Starting October 5, 2026, SGX implemented board lot reduction for 11 stocks including DBS (from 100 to 10 shares), OCBC, and UOB. Stocks priced above S$10 up to S$100 now trade in lots of 10, while shares above S$100 trade single-share lots, making retail access easier.

items.headline: US Equities End Mixed; Nasdaq Hits Record High on Softer Jobs Data and Lower Rate Hike Odds
items.summary: Nasdaq outperformed with +0.5% gain to record high, while S&P 500 slipped 0.3% and Dow fell 1.3%. September jobs report added only 29,000 positions, unemployment rose to 4.2%, and wage growth slowed to 3%, pushing Oct Fed hike odds down to 18-20% from 47% earlier in week.

items.headline: Singapore Stocks Decline on High US Bond Yields; STI Falls 1.3% as City Developments Plunges 14.8%
items.summary: Singapore's Straits Times Index fell 1.3% for the week amid US bond yield surge to 5.34%, highest since 2002. City Developments led declines with 14.8% weekly drop. Rate-sensitive sectors under pressure, with property and finance stocks lagging.
